look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: inspect the finely divided, pinnate leaves and small five-petaled pink flowers. In fruit, look for the unmistakable long narrow storksbill beaks radiating from a cluster; the mature awns can twist into coils. Do not confuse this finely divided-leaf species with the broad heart-shaped leaves of Erodium texanum.
